successCriteria.description: src/shared/types/leave.enums.ts exists and exports three TypeScript string enums: LeaveType with members ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY; LeaveRequestStatus with members DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED; BalanceStatus with members ACTIVE, EXHAUSTED, EXPIRED. Each enum uses string values matching its member names.
src/shared/types/index.ts re-exports all three enums (LeaveType, LeaveRequestStatus, BalanceStatus) from ./leave.enums via named export.

Jest unit tests exist in tests/unit/shared/types/ that verify each enum: correct member count (3 for LeaveType, 5 for LeaveRequestStatus, 3 for BalanceStatus) and correct string value for every member.

constraints: TypeScript strict mode — no implicit any, strict null checks enforced by tsconfig.
Enums must use string values (not numeric) matching their member names for readability and serialization safety.
Tests use Jest framework; test file location: tests/unit/shared/types/.
outOfScope: Any model interfaces, repositories, services, controllers, or routes — these are later phases.
Database access, audit logging, RBAC, input validation — not applicable to enum definitions.
